activity_summary: You said you had copied three leaves fair, folded them once, and put them under the account book. You named the rain and the aquavitae. You did not say why.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the fact of the three leaves, and refused the reason.

entities.name: the three leaves
entities.context: Mentioned in Under the account book

facets.activity: Said where the leaves are, and stopped

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Three leaves. Fair. Folded once. Under the account book.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not saying the rest.
